correctness.rationale: The 78-face octagonal connected-triple complex collapses in 20 fully verified pairs to an eight-vertex triangulation of S^2. Eight-block weak graph maps give the all-parameter integer degree matrix delta_{s,t}-delta_{t,s-1}; its (p-1)x(p-1) unit minor splits Z^{p-1} in H2(K_p;Z). Alexander duality identifies next-to-top integral cohomology; UCT yields the stated split free summand and pure shellability obstruction. Python verifier replay passed, with finite tests explicitly not used as proof of infinite p.
